title: Clinical Diagnostic Laboratory Statement
raw_notes: Patient had routine annual checkup at in-network primary care clinic (Blue Cross Blue Shield). Blood was sent to Quest laboratory. Quest billed out-of-network charge using unbundled CPT codes 80053 and 84443 with zero in-network discount applied, in direct violation of the Federal No Surprises Act.

line_items.name: CPT 80053 Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (OON Non-Discounted)
line_items.details: In-network negotiated rate is $55.00. Billed as $290.00 out-of-network balance bill.

line_items.name: CPT 84443 Thyroid Stimulating Hormone (OON Surcharge)
line_items.details: In-network negotiated rate is $30.00. Billed as $130.00 out-of-network balance bill.
